title: Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature: Who is this poet who made Ancient Greek stories feel new again? Here's what makes her writing so unique
description: Anne Carson has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature, recognizing her innovative literary contributions. The Swedish Academy commended her for creating new forms while engaging with classical traditions. Carson's work encompasses poetry, translation, and essays, profoundly influenced by ancient Greek literature and other traditions. She has adapted ancient myths into contemporary narratives, exploring themes like love, loss, and memory.
